financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Follow-on public offering of 10,000,000 shares of common stock at $23.00 per share
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: After deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and offering costs paid or payable by the Company of approximately $12.0 million, the net proceeds from the offering were approximately $218.0 million.

warrants.quote: In December 2020, the Company issued pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,334,332 shares of common stock in an underwritten public offering at the offering price of the common stock, less the $0.01 per share exercise price of each warrant
